purpose: Describe a gradual change currently underway.
keywords: Vます stem + つつある
The new technology is gradually spreading.
A lost custom is gradually returning.
formation: Vます stem + つつある
restrictions: Typically used with change processes rather than a static state or routine activity.
mistake: It is not a formal replacement for every Vている.
